integrity: All continuous distribution formulas are proved analytically; the numerical program is a finite, reproducible corroboration. Earlier two-level random-matrix spacing methods may supply alternate derivations; no independent audit has been performed.
scientific_limitations: Exact CDF formulas describe the first-order two-dimensional compression of iid uniform diagonal noise for a rank-one 3x3 projection; for fixed nonzero perturbation strength only a uniform deterministic comparison is proved. No larger-dimensional or finite-precision claim.
title: Sharp orientation-dependent level repulsion for a diagonally perturbed two-dimensional null space
